title: Convergence of the Sinkhorn Riemannian metric for finitely supported measures
summary: The Sinkhorn Riemannian metric characterizes the local behavior of the Sinkhorn divergence, a debiased version of entropy-regularized optimal transport. Although the Sinkhorn divergence is known to approximate the squared Wasserstein-2 distance as the regularization parameter $\varepsilon$ goes to $0$, the behavior of the Sinkhorn Riemannian metric as $\varepsilon\to 0$ remains largely open. To the best of our knowledge, the only existing argument is for measures with a density and is still a formal computation.
